faqs.q: How do I order a personalized photo frame?
faqs.a: Choose a frame template, upload your photos into each slot, adjust them until the live preview looks right, pick a size and frame finish, and send us the order on WhatsApp. We confirm the design and payment there.

faqs.q: When should I order for a special occasion?
faqs.a: Please order at least 15 working days before the occasion so there is time to resolve any delays or issues.
A flat ₹50 shipping fee applies to orders up to ₹299. Orders above ₹299 ship free.
Most orders are processed within 1–2 business days after the design and payment are confirmed.

faqs.q: Will the printed frame look exactly like the preview?
faqs.a: The live preview shows your exact layout, crop and text. Printed colours can differ slightly (about 10–20%) from what you see on a screen because of screen brightness and print materials.

faqs.q: Do you edit or retouch my photos?
faqs.a: No — we print the photos exactly as you upload and crop them. If you need colour correction or retouching, contact us on WhatsApp before ordering; extra charges apply.

faqs.q: Can I place a bulk or corporate order?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer special discounts on bulk orders for weddings, corporate gifting and events. Message us on WhatsApp with your requirement.
